main_mechanism: Gate the automatic fanout-aware cross-die placement weight by the observed cross-die net fraction: apply the 1.30/1.15/1.05 factors only when cross-die nets are at most 12% of all PlaceDB nets; otherwise keep unit net weights. An explicit non-unit cross_die_net_weight remains authoritative.
physical_invariants: Net weights remain finite and positive; only nets with assigned endpoints on both dies are candidates for automatic scaling.
When the cross-die fraction exceeds 12%, automatic weighting is disabled and cross-die weights remain at their incoming values.
Die assignment, physical connectivity, netlist identity, PDK/Liberty/LEF/SDC and clock definitions are not rewritten.
Placement units, target density, site/row geometry, macro-halo constraints and PDN special wires are untouched.
GRT overflow, DRC, unrouted nets, PDN special wires and HBT endpoint checks remain acceptance gates.
portability_obligation: The rule depends on valid partition assignment, cross-die net identity and PlaceDB net/pin metadata. tradeoff_statement: The guard gives up potential cross-die timing pull on high-cut designs but avoids over-constraining a large shared-net set and adding local congestion. It does not change density, legality, area, power or runtime guarantees, and its 12% threshold is an empirically derived proxy rather than a calibrated criticality model.
